card.name: Linking words in surfactant dosing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (of, including, with, a comma) just before the surfactant name or the dose in label text for lung surfactants such as SURVANTA, CUROSURF and INFASURF.

modes.label: Linking word before surfactant
modes.description: A word like of, including or with that comes just before a surfactant name or a condition such as surfactant deficiency.
modes.example: The administration of exogenous surfactants,<< including>> CUROSURF, can rapidly affect

modes.label: Space before dose amount
modes.description: The blank space after 'dose is' just before a mL/kg amount for a surfactant.
modes.example: The recommended dose of INFASURF is<< >>3 mL/kg body weight at birth.

card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in newborn lung surfactant dosing instructions, right before the product name or amount.
